_comment: Which projects the question generator draws from, and how many questions come from each.
This default targets ONE project, the seed, so the benchmark runs out of the box. Point it at
your own project by changing 'dir', or add more entries: the shape is multi-project and always
has been, one is just the sensible default. See projects.example.json for a three project set,
and docs/07-benchmarking.md for what the groups mean.
'n' is a target rather than a promise. A stratum with no population in your project comes up
short and the generator says so in the Shortfalls section rather than inventing questions.

_cpp_callers_comment: The C++ half of a blast radius key, which the artefacts cannot supply because they carry
only Blueprint edges. Hand written and hand verified, so only worth doing for a project
small enough to keep them true. Verified by grep over seed/AccelDemo/Source.
Leave this out for a large project: the generator then marks the key as needing the C++
half added by hand, which is honest, rather than carrying a stale answer.

cpp_callers.ADStaminaComponent::ApplyStamina: Three C++ callers: the deferred lambda in `AADCharacter::BeginPlay` (*ADCharacter.cpp:31*), `AADCharacter::OnInteracted` (*ADCharacter.cpp:65*), and the regen path in `UADStaminaComponent::TickComponent` (*ADStaminaComponent.cpp:46*). Four callers in total, and a C++ only answer is wrong rather than merely partial
cpp_callers.ADCharacter::IsAlive: No C++ callers at all. It is an inline `BlueprintPure` accessor declared in the header and nothing in C++ calls it, so the Blueprint graph is the only caller in the project. An agent that reports "no callers" has found the C++ truth and missed the answer
cpp_callers.ADCharacter::MaxHealth: Two C++ reads: the clamp in `AADCharacter::ApplyDamage` (*ADCharacter.cpp:44*) and the reset in the respawn path (*ADCharacter.cpp:80*)
